title: pocket.session.Session
description:
Session is a fully hydrated session object that contains all the information for the Session
and its participants.

application.title: A fully hydrated application object this session is for

header.title: The header of the session containing lightweight data

num_blocks_per_session.title: The number of blocks per session when this session started

session_id.title: A unique pseudorandom ID for this session

suppliers.title: A fully hydrated set of servicers that are serving the application
